installCommand: if [ ! -d frontend ]; then cd ..; fi; cd frontend && ELECTRON_SKIP_BINARY_DOWNLOAD=1 pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
buildCommand: SUB=0; if [ ! -d frontend ]; then SUB=1; cd ..; fi; cd frontend && pnpm run build:web && mkdir -p api backend/src && cp -r ../api/. api/ && cp -r ../backend/src/. backend/src/ && if [ "$SUB" = "1" ]; then mkdir -p frontend && cp -r dist frontend/; fi
